_comment: Locked USB webcam controls (Logitech C270, outdoor daylight). "*" = every USB camera; a camview id key (e.g. usb-3-1-1-1-0) overrides single controls for that port, null = leave that control alone. Mode controls are written first automatically. Changing values mid-dataset makes episodes inconsistent: start a new batch. See docs/camera-controls.md.
